chunks.heading: Mechanism
chunks.body: The paper studies portfolios that reduce exposure when recent volatility is high. Its reported benefit is risk-adjusted performance, motivated by volatility being forecastable without a proportional rise in expected return; this is a research premise, not evidence that an Ostium implementation is profitable.

chunks.heading: Transfer boundary
chunks.body: Alquímia does not import ex-post optimal weights or the paper's historical result. It freezes a bounded, long-only, prior-information rule and must test turnover, current costs, small-account sizing and temporal transfer independently.
